harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-only SSH access. The supplied RSA public key, locked password, SSH policy, service health, and persistence were verified after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin with home directory /home/opsadmin and shell /bin/bash.
Installed the supplied RSA public key with correct ownership and 0700/0600 permissions.
Enabled public-key authentication and disabled password, challenge-response, and GSSAPI authentication.
Restarted node1 safely and verified full recovery without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and supplied public key
evidence.summary: Shows the account, locked password, secure file permissions, exact authorized-key match, and 2048-bit RSA fingerprint before and after restart.
Validated sshd configuration enables public-key authentication and disables password, challenge-response, and GSSAPI methods. Live probes were rejected with only publickey offered.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 are unchanged across restart.

Captures healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, boot-ID change from faf7b98c-f8bb-44ab-8000-000000000000 to d679a033-df86-43e9-8000-000000000000, and recovered account data, key, SSH policy, daemon, listener, and authentication behavior.
